scope: Offline static Zoom/Meet meeting and speaker integration investigation; no target execution or account/private data access.
raw_capture_policy: Raw proprietary packages, decompiled output and exact code excerpts stay outside tracked public data. Metadata indexes contain hashes, locations, IDs, limitations and paraphrases only. Some historical subject paths refer to ignored scratch/detached mounts; custody records identify retained copies.
evidence_boundaries: Static paths are not runtime execution or accuracy measurements.
Manual inert JS reading supplements REA partial graph/semantic coverage; automated end-to-end proof is not claimed.
LLVM disassembly, where used, is separate evidence from REA/Ghidra decompilation.
ASAR integrity contradictions remain recorded as untrusted observations.
Matching installed versions and source tags do not prove reproducible binary/source equivalence.
